description: This file contains helper functions and a class for managing shopping lists and recipe-related shopping operations within a Django project, including filtering, creating, editing, and deleting shopping list entries.

classes.name: RecipeShoppingEditor
classes.description: A class for creating, editing, and managing shopping list entries related to recipes and meal plans, including handling servings and ingredient scaling.

methods.name: shopping_helper
methods.description: Filters and orders a queryset of shopping list items based on supermarket, checked status, and user preferences.

methods.name: RecipeShoppingEditor.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the shopping editor with user, space, and optional parameters, resolving related objects like mealplan and recipe.

methods.name: RecipeShoppingEditor._recipe_servings
methods.description: Returns the number of servings for the current recipe or related objects.

methods.name: RecipeShoppingEditor._servings_factor
methods.description: Calculates the scaling factor based on current servings and recipe servings.

methods.name: RecipeShoppingEditor._shared_users
methods.description: Returns a list of users sharing the shopping list.

methods.name: RecipeShoppingEditor.get_shopping_list_recipe
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping list recipe object by ID, filtering by user and space.

methods.name: RecipeShoppingEditor.get_recipe_ingredients
methods.description: Fetches ingredients for a given recipe ID, optionally excluding on-hand items.

methods.name: RecipeShoppingEditor.create
methods.description: Creates a new shopping list entry with optional ingredients, mealplan, recipe, and servings.

methods.name: RecipeShoppingEditor.edit
methods.description: Edits the shopping list, including servings and ingredients.

methods.name: RecipeShoppingEditor.edit_servings
methods.description: Adjusts the servings and scales ingredient amounts accordingly.

methods.name: _add_ingredients
methods.description: Adds ingredients to the shopping list, avoiding duplicates and scaling amounts.

methods.name: _delete_ingredients
methods.description: Removes ingredients from the shopping list that are not in the provided list.
